message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on incoming data; the code simply passes paths to ImageFolder and transforms without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; no remote fetching is performed, and no checksum or integrity verification is present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained AlexNet weights via torchvision.models.alexnet(pretrained=True) and InceptionResnetV1 is imported, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned model revision is performed before or after loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics exist (accuracy, top_k_acc, utt_accuracy), there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, cryptographic signing/hashing of evaluation data, or other explicit tamper-protection mechanisms.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies only standard torchvision/albumentations transforms (resize, normalize) with no explicit shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: The metric and model code use argmax/topk directly on raw outputs with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or confidence thresholding before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/audio classification model (AlexNet, InceptionResnetV1), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
